title: Namely - All-in-one HCM platform for small-to-mid-sized US companies
clean_text: Namely combines HR, payroll, time, benefits, and talent software into a single platform for small-to-mid-sized US companies (roughly 25-1,000 employees), with core HR, time tracking, payroll, benefits administration, and basic recruiting/performance modules, emphasizing employee self-service on any device and an easy-to-use interface. The platform spans four tiers from a self-service entry plan up to Namely Complete, a white-glove comprehensive PEO solution for companies wanting to expand while minimizing risk and liability.
